experience: Junior Research Fellow and Ph.D. Researcher

Heritage-document analysis, structure-aware segmentation, privacy-preserving document management, and face image quality assessment. Translating research into full-stack systems with Docker deployment, institutional hosting, and human-in-the-loop archival workflows.

Fine-tuned LLM framework for drone delivery with Open-Meteo weather data, dynamic route planning, energy-efficient battery management, and multi-drone coordination. Developed datasets and weather-aware modules for sustainable drone logistics.
CT data-acquisition simulation and image reconstruction using Filtered Back-Projection and deep learning to improve image quality and reduce artifacts.
Developed the Dynamic Batch Size Adjuster (DBSA), using loss functions and gradient norms to adapt batch sizes for improved training convergence, stability, and efficiency.
Child face aging through latent-space manipulation and explainable AI for face image quality assessment, with applications in forensics and healthcare.
3D ultrasound compounding for volume estimation in thyroid diagnostics and multimodal thyroid registration using PyTorch.
Automatic image enhancement using optimal gamma values and machine learning with TensorFlow, PyTorch, and JAX.
Statistical learning, regression, classification, dimensionality reduction, Python programming, real analysis, and linear algebra.
